title: kardomia squarrulosa
intro: Kardomia squarrulosa, commonly known as Coastal Kandos, is a plant species native to Australia, belonging to the family Myoporaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various infections. The therapeutic actions of Kardomia squarrulosa include antioxidant, antiproliferative, and antiviral activities, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of various diseases, such as cancer and viral infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified and studied in the plant's extracts.
